column1: # Covariate gene sets: per-cell programmes a fit can model as a second axis
# of batch (senna --covariate). Columns: covariate, set, kind, symbol.
# kind "share" scores a set as its share of the cell's counts; "module" as a
# module score (mean log expression minus that of expression-matched control
# genes, Tirosh et al. 2016). A covariate with two sets gives two scores.
# Fetched 2026-11-26 from the sources below; symbols as published.
# mito: HGNC gene groups 1974 (mitochondrially encoded protein-coding),
#   1378 (rRNAs) and 843 (tRNAs); HGNC complete set of 2026-11-23, CC0.
#   Seal RL et al. Nucleic Acids Res 51:D1003-D1009 (2023). doi:10.1093/nar/gkac888
# ribo: HGNC gene groups 729 (L ribosomal proteins) and 728 (S ribosomal
#   proteins), cytoplasmic, without the Y-linked RPS4Y1 and RPS4Y2 (which
#   would measure sex); same HGNC snapshot and citation.
# sex: XIST (female) against RPS4Y1, EIF1AY, DDX3Y, KDM5D (male), the panel of
# stress: the 140 dissociation-induced genes (mouse symbols, as published) of
#   van den Brink SC et al. Nat Methods 14:935-936 (2017). doi:10.1038/nmeth.4437
#   (Supplementary Table 5). Matched case-insensitively they find the human
#   genes sharing a symbol; the paper gives no human list.
# hypoxia, interferon: MSigDB Hallmark HYPOXIA, INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE and
#   Liberzon A et al. Cell Syst 1:417-425 (2015). doi:10.1016/j.cels.2015.12.004
